proposed_additions.question: For Duke Leto Atreides, which board-space category does Landsraad Popularity discount, by how much, and does that change the cost paid to enter the space? What cost and relative-Influence condition apply to Prudent Diplomacy; may it target a Faction where no opponent has more Influence than Leto?
proposed_additions.fixed_answer: Landsraad Popularity reduces the Solari entry cost of a Landsraad-icon (green) board space by 1 when Leto sends an Agent there; apply that reduction to the entry cost before resolving the space or played card. It is not a discount on spaces with other Agent icons. When Leto activates Prudent Diplomacy with Signet Ring, he may pay 1 spice to gain 1 Influence with a Faction where at least one opponent has more Influence than he does. A Faction where no opponent is ahead is ineligible; a tie alone is insufficient.

proposed_additions.novelty: This tests a printed modifier to otherwise mandatory Agent-entry cost and a relative-opponent eligibility condition for gaining Influence. These are distinct rule restrictions, not new card statistics substituted into already-tested arithmetic, and they are not obtained by mechanically recombining existing effects. Q23 supplies only generic Leader timing, while Q04/Q05 do not ask how an entry-cost modifier operates. Q33 asks absolute numeric Influence/Alliance prerequisites, not whether an opponent must be strictly ahead.
proposed_additions.recommended_integration: Add as one combined named-Leader question or add its two explicit clauses to Q23; do not count the repeated timing context as additional novelty.

proposed_additions.question: How does House Hagal’s original Harvest Spice card select a Maker space and break a tie, and what happens if no space has bonus spice? In two-player play, where does the harvested bonus spice go?
proposed_additions.fixed_answer: Choose the Maker space with the most bonus spice; if bonus amounts tie, choose by total spice (base plus bonus). If no space has any bonus spice, reveal another House Hagal card rather than harvesting the space with the highest base value. In two-player play return the removed bonus spice to the bank; House Hagal does not accumulate it.
